response.overview: A single-take film that documents a group of teenage boys playing, chatting, chasing and dancing on the pyramid playground commissioned by Create and LBBD and made by Eva Rothschild at Parsloes Park in Dagenham. Challenging the often negative attitudes towards groups of boys, the film shows us young men unselfconsciously inhabiting public space, enjoying physical engagement with the structure and each other in a spirit of joy, discovery and friendship.
